# TruffleHog path exclusions (gitignore-syntax allowlist of what to SKIP).
# Rationale: build artifacts and vendored binaries are not secret-bearing and
# choke the scanner on mach-o/PE chunks (brotli PADDING errors → exit 183).
# Everything under these dirs is generated output, never source.

# Rust build artifacts (174MB of compiled binaries/deps)
target/

bin/
obj/
artifacts/
nupkg/
sbom/

# Node
node_modules/
out/

# Python caches
.pytest_cache/
.mypy_cache/
.ruff_cache/

# Benchmark artifacts
BenchmarkDotNet.Artifacts/

# Local harness state (not source)
.omp/
.omo/
.codegraph/
.codex/
.claude/
